execution.zipInspection: Python zipfile and hashlib.sha256 over the downloaded original archive bytes
execution.syntaxInspection: Node.js v22.16.0 and TypeScript v5.8.3 createSourceFile AST
execution.parsing: Readonly JavaScript/TypeScript under scripts/ folders; no map ZIP extracted back to the original; case-specific scratch copies only

methodology.caseSelection: Four calibration (development-visible), differently packaged Minecraft map archives with stored external artifact IDs and known SHA-256. No acceptance/holdout cases were inspected.
methodology.literalTranslate: AST PropertyAssignment named translate with StringLiteralLike initializer (including no-substitution template strings); no UI reachability inferred.
methodology.dynamicTranslate: AST PropertyAssignment named translate without a StringLiteralLike initializer; dynamic template/other values never resolved or treated as literal.
methodology.directUiCallArgumentSyntax: Walk only through static object/array literal containment and syntactic TS wrappers to a direct CallExpression argument of a property access whose spelling is sendMessage/setTitle/setActionBar. Reject spread, helper invocation, variable indirection and unsupported expression forms. Name-only match: receiver typing, actual UI delivery, activation and gameplay semantics are NOT verified.
methodology.indirectLiteralTranslateObjects: Static literal translate objects not satisfying that direct argument syntax; may be definitions, inert constants, rawtext builders or helper inputs. Do NOT count as missed delivered UI.
methodology.uiMethodNameCallSites: AST call expression whose callee property is named sendMessage/setTitle/setActionBar. Receiver may not be Minecraft typed and an authored call is not execution.
methodology.localeDefinitionEntries: Sum of nonempty, noncomment key=value lines as last distinct keys per physical .lang file, across all locale files; neither unique winning key nor effective resource-pack selection.
methodology.manifestEntry: Every inspected archive contained declared script main entry and world BP/RP list records; declaration is not runtime initialization.
methodology.metricsMeaning: Counts are an independent structural source census, NOT canonical engine output, semantic TP/FP/FN/TN, detection recall, PROVEN findings, or a before/after benchmark delta.

maps.note: Direct literal UI argument syntax exists; future typed IR and runtime verification remain independent.
Many literal translation values belong to presentation builders/helper calls or static palettes, not direct typed API call arguments.
No direct literal UI argument syntax among the observed static translate objects; substantial authored constants and helper-based presentation values remain unbound.
Dynamic template translation key is not a static literal and cannot be resolved by matching a fixed locale key.

findings.firstEvidence: The direct-literal-only UI-send witness recognizes one narrow source form; modular, chunked helper/palette, and bundled dynamic-key sources have materially different source structures.
findings.recommendedNextSourceOwner: engine/analyzers/scripts/src/parser/parse.ts plus existing Semantic IR source identity and Gameplay Intent adapter, not a detector based on game names or UI wording.
findings.safeNextDevelopment: Add bounded, unambiguous, provenance-preserving literal value/argument forwarding for exact constants and helper handoffs; retain explicit UNKNOWN for dynamic keys, branch ambiguity, mutated aliases, and untyped receivers. Avoid turning helper proximity into authenticated delivery or approved design.
findings.benchmarkDecision: No canonical exact-head runSelectedMapAudit result or independently adjudicated full-map output was executed, therefore PROVEN/NEED_VALIDATION delta and TP/FP/FN/TN denominators are UNSCORABLE. Frozen expectations and acceptance cases remain unchanged.
findings.knownGoodProtection: Language copy, palette constants, source API calls and prepared script entrypoints do not prove player victory, live message delivery, Minecraft execution or absence of bugs.

limitations: Counts of AST syntax are not results returned by the M-Lazy-Developer gameplay parser or selected-map audit entrypoint.
A direct method-spelling match lacks receiver resolution; do not present it as a proven Minecraft Script API call.
No runtime package selection, event firing, guard satisfaction, player identity or Minecraft gameplay observation.
Archive source structure and frozen corpus expectation ID do not automatically create a scorable full-map benchmark.
Private map binaries, raw scripts and locale texts are not committed in this record; only SHA-bound aggregate counts.
